jobs_results.title: Especialista hubgrade - gestión de datos
jobs_results.description:
Descripción de la empresa

El grupo Veolia tiene la ambición de volverse la empresa de referencia de la transformación ecológica. Presente en los cinco continentes con cerca de 179 000 empleados, el Grupo diseña e implementa soluciones útiles y concretas para la gestión de agua, residuos y energía que ayudan a cambiar radicalmente el panorama. Con sus tres actividades complementarias, Veolia contribuye al desarrollo del acceso a los recursos así como a la preservación y renovación de los recursos disponibles. En 2020, el grupo Veolia abasteció de agua potable a 95 millones de personas y prestó servicio de saneamiento a 62 millones, produjo cerca de 43 millones de MWh y valorizó 47 millones de toneladas de residuos.

Veolia Latam-Iberia está especializada en la gestión integral de Agua y Residuos y energía para clientes municipales e industriales de toda América Latina, España y Portugal. Actualmente está presente en 11 países (Argentina, Brasil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, México... Panamá, Perú, Uruguay, Portugal y España).

Veolia en México consolida su presencia y liderazgo local con soluciones medio ambientales de agua, residuos y energía para municipios e industrias.

Nuestra misión es generar valor para nuestros clientes ofreciendo las soluciones más completas en la gestión integral de agua, residuos y energía para contribuir a la mejora de la calidad de vida de las personas y al cuidado del ambiente.

La empresa gestiona anualmente en el país 2.3 millones de toneladas de Residuos Sólidos en tratamiento y 800 mil en recolección y potabiliza aproximadamente 500MMm3 de agua, alcanzando más de 20 ciudades atendidas y 13 millones de usuarios en sus dos actividades.

En cuanto al sector industrial, Veolia México garantiza un servicio responsable y eficiente en el tratamiento y disposición final de residuos sólidos y residuos peligrosos.

Muestra de ello son los más de 7,000 clientes satisfechos en México y América latina, con los que estamos comprometidos, dando servicio a grandes corporaciones multinacionales como a empresas locales

Descripción del empleo

Solicitamos:

Especialista Hubgrade - Gestión de datos

Roles & Responsabilidades:

Realizar la construcción de procesos ETLs (Extraer, Transformar y Cargar), bases de datos y manejo SQL para los diferentes proyectos del área

Procesar los datos usando diferentes métodos estadísticos, para el análisis de datos históricos para detectar oportunidades de mejora y eficiencias en los sitios así como en su entorno

Implementar herramientas de inteligencia de negocios (Business Intelligence) para analizar información, mediante el seguimiento de KPI´S

Transferir conocimientos con los sitios para mantener operativos los procesos ya implementados

Requisitos

Perfil académico : Lic en sistemas, Ing Civil, hidráulica o afín. Al no contar con esta educación se considerará la experiencia laboral y cargos anteriores respecto a los conocimientos académicos que se requieren y la experiencia práctica adquirida.

Conocimientos básicos de eléctrica, mecánica, instrumentación, control, manejo de datos, operación de PTAR, ETAP, plantas, etc.

Experiencia:

· 2 años como especialista en cuartos de control y sistemas de monitoreo, operación y/o mantenimiento de PTARs.
· Desarrollo de paneles de seguimiento.

Competencias duras:

· Uso de aplicaciones para monitoreo de las operaciones con sistema SCADA
· Manejo de equipo de cómputo y conocimiento de las principales herramientas informáticas
· Manejo y desarrollo de ambientes business intelligence
• Posición con base en Ciudad de México
• Disponibilidad de viajar

Información adicional

As an inclusive company, Veolia is committed to diversity and gives equal consideration to all applications, without discrimination

jobs_results.title: Project Manager BI
jobs_results.description:
Queremos incorporar a un/a Project Manager para unirse a nuestro equipo.

Pensamos en una persona con una experiencia mínima de 10 años gestionando proyectos IT preferentemente de BI, basados en metodologías agiles. Atenderás el pool de nuestros clientes más potentes y con mayor posibilidad de crecimiento y desarrollo, todo un reto con una trayectoria profesional que conquistar.

Tus funciones principales serán las siguientes:
• Planificación de proyectos y asignación de recursos según necesidades.
• Seguimiento de los timmings establecidos y asegurar su cumplimiento.
• Supervisión del trabajo realizado y solución de incidencias.
• Coordinación del equipo humano durante todas las fases del proyecto.
• Atención personalizada a cada miembro del equipo.
• Colaborar con el cliente y el KAM en la definición de los objetivos y evolutivos.
• Detección de errores y búsqueda de soluciones.
• Presentación de resultados e información a través de reportes visuales.
• Identificar las posibles... desviaciones, proponer y gestionar las modificaciones técnicas, económicas y temporales del plan de trabajo para la ejecución del proyecto.
• Detectar nuevas oportunidades de negocio y crecimiento orgánico, con el soporte del KAM.

Qué requerimos:
• Experiencia mínima de 10 años como Project Manager, mínimo 2 en proyectos de BI, preferentemente Microsoft (planificación, ejecución, supervisión, control y cierre de proyectos).
• Persona habituada a gestionar un equipo de personas y liderar iniciativas con varios interlocutores.
• Experiencia en análisis de datos, visión estratégica y actitud proactiva.
• Habilidades comunicativas con diferentes niveles de interlocución (cliente, equipo, KAM…)
• Nivel alto de inglés (mínimo B2).
• Experiencia en creación de consultas básicas en SQL.
• Conocimientos de soluciones de Business Intelligence.
• Experiencia en metodologías agiles (scrum, safe, etc)
• Conocimientos en herramientas de visualización y explotación de datos (muy valorable Power BI).
• Valorable certificaciones en gestión de proyectos; PMP, Prince 2, ITIL, Scrum Master…

Qué ofrecemos:
• Trabajar en Empresa líder con referentes técnicos de alto nivel, especialistas en entorno BI Microsoft.
• Formación continua tanto interna como externa.
• Buen ambiente de trabajo y posibilidad de desarrollo.
• Paquete retributivo según valores aportados.

Jornada trabajo híbrida (3 días semana teletrabajo) y flexibilidad horaria

jobs_results.title: EMEA Claims Operations Business Intelligence Lead
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

If working with one of the largest commercial insurers in the world appeals, then we would love to hear from you!

EMEA Claims Operations MI/BI team (Management Information & Business Intelligence) is required to provide deep data insights to COG, regional EMEA Leadership & local claims clusters/countries heads and SLT.

This ranges from typical claims trend analytics with already defined KPI’s, trend developments over time, up to sophisticated predictive trend forecast & staffing models with respective management recommendations.

This position is responsible for assisting in leading the data, reporting and analytics strategy in EMEA Claims Operations. In this capacity, you will work closely with EMEA business unit leaders to support the MI/BI initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
• The EMEA Claims Operations Business Intelligence Lead will be assisting in the development of the data strategy for EMEA claims and associated strategic projects and data reporting.
•... Establish a strong understanding & connection with IT data sources where needed to generate, validate & discuss data sources and validity.
• Communicating & building sustainable relationships with Claims Handlers, IT, Data and actuarial department as well as other key internal departments in Chubb EMEA.
• The EMEA Claims Operations Business Intelligence Lead will assist in the oversight, automation and development of dashboards, reports and trending analysis.
• Deliver statistical analysis to identify performance development opportunities and build cases for change.
• Strong focus on Chubb’s Claims Craftmanship modules & MI/BI relevant training on all Chubb systems, data manipulation & digital innovations.
• Actively drive self-studies to assure to be up to date & assure sustainable knowledge bench-strength.
• To work within the framework of CHUBB ethical and service standards and adhere to current WFH local regulations.
• Demonstrate flexibility, agile attitude, team cooperation, lean & 6Sigma mindset and long-term business thinking.

Requirements & Experience
• SQL, statistical modelling software e.g. R, Python, Excel (advanced), Qlik Sense, Access, Cognos
• Strong verbal and written communication skills. Proficiency in translating detailed reporting outputs, trends, and statistics into executive-level reporting and presentations: distil complex analytical techniques and results into actionable insights and articulate their implications for business decisions and outcomes.
• Exposure to using operational MI to supervise and achieve business targets / objectives and the ability to prove their contribution has improved the performance of the business.
• Excellent project management lead and organisation skills. Experience managing technical staff preferred.
• proven experience in an analytics driven role. Experience in building statistics and business insight to optimise business decisions.
• Strong sense of execution & accountability with ability of explain complex matters in a simple way with the main stakeholder. Such as internal stakeholder RCCM’s, Claims Director’s, LOB heads and SME’s in the respective areas.
• Very strong analytical thinking on a regional level is required and being able to drive conclusions in anticipating future trends and develop relevant hypotheses to be verified or falsified using the best data insights.
• A sense of entrepreneurial mentality is encouraged, with the ability to lead meetings with tight data delivery deadlines and under pressure.
• Very Strong communication skills and again outstanding ability to explain complex fundamentals in simple terms. At least 5 years plus relevant work experience in Insurance or equivalent industry.
• University degree or equivalent experience in Business Administration or Mathematical/Statistics science preferred or equivalent qualifications in an international environment of a global corporation or consulting.
• * Fluent in English and one/two other relevant local languages preferred. English (must), German, French, Spanish,... is recommended.ADKAR

We offer in return!
• Competitive salary & pension scheme, annual bonus scheme, 25 days annual leave plus ability to purchase 5 additional days, Private Medical cover, Employee Share Purchase Plan, Life Assurance, Subsidised gym membership, Comprehensive Learning & development offerings.
• Employee resource groups, Networking, mentoring & development opportunities, 1 day annual Charitable leave, Cycle to work scheme, Active Sports & social committee, Employee Assistance program

Integrity. Client focus. Respect. Excellence. Teamwork

Our core values dictate how we live and work. We’re an ethical and honest company that’s wholly committed to its clients. A business that’s engaged in mutual trust and respect for its employees and partners. A place where colleagues perform at the highest levels. And a working environment that’s collaborative and supportive.

Diversity & Inclusion. At Chubb we consider our people our chief competitive advantage and as such we treat colleagues, candidates, clients, and business partners with equality, fairness and respect, regardless of their age, disability, race, religion or belief, gender, sexual orientation, marital status or family circumstances.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation

jobs_results.title: 2024 Business Intelligence Engineer Internship
jobs_results.description:
Description

We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you’re ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth.

How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow

2024 Business Intelligence Engineer Internship - Spain

Do you enjoy solving complex problems and troubleshooting products? Are you passionate about developing test strategies, finding, and tracking bugs to resolution, and innovating on behalf of customers? Do you want to be a part of a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and contribute to one of the most visited sites on the Internet?

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate on behalf of our customers. The intense focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved... brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Business intelligence engineers use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand.

The challenges business intelligence engineers solve for at Amazon are big and affect millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. Our path is not always simple, so we are selective about who joins us on this journey. There is a certain kind of person who takes on this role at Amazon – someone who is excited by the idea of creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company whose ship cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

The Amazon EU Student Programs Team are looking for ambitious students to join us as interns at the heart of our core consumer business! Internships are flexible in length to fit in with your university’s placement scheme.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop analytical solutions to business problems that utilize the highest standards of analytical rigor and data integrity
• Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation
• Write high quality code to retrieve and analyze data
• Analyze and solve business problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context
• Design pragmatic analyses and automated metrics that add value to your business area
• Understand data resources and how, when, and what to use (and what not to use).
• Develop analyses (whether fully formed or exploratory) for the business’ sake, not for analyses’ sake
• Seek to understand the business objectives relevant to your area, and align your work to those objectives and seek to deliver business value
• Proactively and continually, improve your level of knowledge about Amazon’s business and relevant data resources

A day in the life

Our Business Intelligence Engineer builds data pipelines, reports, dashboards, and analyses to deliver metrics and insights to the business.

Our Business Intelligence Engineers tackle some of the most complex challenges in large scale

computing, work in small teams across the company to contribute to the e-commerce platform that's used by millions of people all over the world. With that in mind, we require applicants to demonstrate their technical skills in a number of areas.

About The Team

If you’re insatiably curious and always want to learn more, then you’ve come to the right place. Depending on your location, country, job status and other requirements, some or all of the following benefits may be available to you as an intern.
• Roles also within Barcelona
• Competitive pay
• Impactful project and internship/role deliverables
• Hybrid working (team dependent)
• Networking opportunities with fellow interns
• Internships events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions.
• Mentorship and career development

If you’re successful during your internship, you could be considered for a graduate role after finishing your university studies.

Internship start dates vary throughout the year.

Internship length is ideally 6 months.

We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and leveraging our unique perspectives to scale our impact and grow. Amazon has 13 affinity groups (https://www.aboutamazon.com/affinity-groups), sometimes known as employee resource groups, which bring employees together across businesses and locations around the world. With executive and company sponsorship, these groups play an important role in building internal networks for creating a community, advising Amazon business units, leading in service projects, and reaching out to communities where Amazonians live and work.

Want to know more about our opportunities? Visit our EMEA Student Programs Team Events page to register for one of our upcoming events: https://amazonstudentevents.splashthat.com/careers

We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations:

Madrid, M, ESP

Basic Qualifications
• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in computer engineering, computer science, or a similar technical field
• Availability to complete ideally a 6 months internship working full time week
• Advanced knowledge and/or experience using SQL
• Experience with data querying or modelling with SQL, Excel
• Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
• Knowledge of BI analytics/reporting/visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, AWS QuickSight, COGNOS, or other third-party tools)

Preferred Qualifications
• Master’s or advanced technical degree
• Experience with BI analytics/ reporting/visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, AWS QuickSight, COGNOS, or other third-party tools)
• Experience in data mining, data warehouse solutions, and ETL, and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
• Knowledge of algorithm design and complexity analysis
• Ability to deal with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment
• Excellent verbal/written communication skills and data presentation skills

EMEA Student Programs Team

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. jobs_results.title: Senior BI Analyst
jobs_results.description:
About the role

As a BI Analyst, you will interact with big data architects, software developers, and business experts to understand how data needs to be converted, loaded, processed, and presented for LIDL analytics products.

You will contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, performance in production and maintenance of the data-centric software including APIs, libraries, toolbox…

Ready to be part of the challenge?

In this Role, you’ll get to

Development to industrialize the following workflow:
• Dashboard development and maintenance in an international project.
• Design and development of efficient models from a data warehouse.
• ETL development needed to feed models.
• Script development to load data.
• Build apps and or objects in Power BI.
• Work on dashboard refreshes’ plan.
• Document processes, data structure, content, and models from both technical and business point of view.

Required Skills
• Language Required: advanced SQL, Valuable: Python.
• Big... Data Platforms Required: Databricks or Snowflake.
• Data Base: relational (SQL Server).
• Experience in Agile methodology.
• Control Version with Git.
• As a bonus, knowledge of DBT, Airflow, Azure or Spark framework.
• Passion for learning new tools, languages, and frameworks.
• Ability to be creative and innovation-minded, self-motivated, and proactive.
• Fast adaptation to changing requirements and strong problem-solving skills.
• To work in a collaborative model, side by side with the business.
• Fluency in English to work in a multi-cultural environment.
• Experience managing large volume data.
• MS’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
• 2+ years’ experience in Big Data Frameworks.

About us

Who we are

SCRM was created in 2015 with a vision of the future that foresaw “business and technology forever remaining intertwined”, and a steadfast mission to guide traditional businesses towards digital evolution through their clients, data, commercial strategies and omnichannel communication. Specialising in digital strategy, automation and real-time offer and content customisation, SCRM owes its success and efficiency to the use of cloud computing and the development of data platforms which rely on artificial intelligence for automatic decision-making in largescale consumer and retail markets.

SCRM Lidl International Hub - Three years later, Lidl has absorbed the company and turned it into their international hub of digitalisation and customer intelligence. Amongst our missions as Lidl’s International Hub, we would highlight the following: The conceptualisation and development of Lidl Plus, a Lidl international relational programme, and its benefit plan, which will offer discounts, exclusive services, agreements with third-party entities and financial services as its fundamental features; The creation of a cloud-based international platform for big data; The development of an international marketing automation platform; The conceptualisation, development and management of business intelligence platforms; The creation of an omnichannel payment platform; The development of advanced analytics and machine learning platforms favouring customer recommendation, foresight and analysis systems; The creation and implementation of an omnichannel, single sign-on strategy to generate business opportunities amongst the group’s diverse range of commercial platforms and services.

Our Mission & Vision

Our Vision as SCRM is to digitalize the Schwarz Group. SCRM provide digital tools to all Schwarz businesses that enables them to understand and connect with the customer to boost their revenues.

Values

Do you want to know more about our Culture?

We are Family: Yes, we are colleagues, but we like to have fun while working. As a real family, we suffer in hard times and celebrate together in good times, as equals and with respect. In fact, we like better the Spanish word Colegas, which includes a sense of friendship.

Passion by Design: Passion is at the very heart of everything we do. Over at HQ, they say this is a because of the sunny Barcelona and our Latin vibes. The reality… it's because we love what we do.

Innovation as a Service: We don’t deliver technology; we deliver creation & transformation. Challenging the status quo is what inspire us because we want to lead the next generation of grocery business.

Make it happen: Every day is an opportunity to make a difference. Do something good today, improve it tomorrow and don’t stop until it’s awesome.

Think Big: Don’t let what is already done draw the boundaries of what’s coming next, this is the only way to go beyond what it is expected.

Perks of being part of our team

• An awesome team 😄😄

• Competitive salary 💰💰

• Social benefits plan 📊📊

- Restaurant ticket for 170€/month 🍽🍽

- Transport ticket for 55€ x 11 months 🚊🚊

- Tax free benefit for Childcare

- Health & Accident insurance 🩺🩺

• Hybrid remote-office work 🏡🏡

• Flexible schedule ⏰ and no dress code!😀😀

• Possibility intensive timetable in July & August 🌞🌞

• 24 days of holidays per year 🌴🌴

• Language lessons: German, English & Spanish

• Referral bonus 🤝🤝

• Continuous learning and development programs 🎓🎓

• 300€ Wellbeing voucher (To do your favourite sport)

• Filtered water, biscuits, fresh fruit, wide selection of teas and coffee (Nespresso, what else?)☕ 🍎🍎

• Work in one of the top 10 IT hubs in BCN located in Plaza Catalunya 💻💻

Join the challenge!

SCRM provides equal employment opportunities to any job applicant or employee and confirms that it is committed to ensuring that there shall be no direct or indirect discrimination against, or harassment of, job applicants or employees on grounds of race, creed, colour, ethnic origin, nationality, gender, gender reassignment or transsexualism, religious or other similar beliefs, age, marital or family status, sexual orientation, or disability. SCRM recruits, hires, promotes, transfers, takes disciplinary action, and makes all personnel decisions, including those related to compensation and benefits, in a non-discriminatory manner and in accordance with applicable laws.

We hereby inform you that SOCIAL BIGDATA COMUNICACIÓN, S.L.U. (hereinafter “SCRM” or “we”) located at calle Bergara 13, 4ª, 08002 Barcelona, Spain, with telephone number +34 937076017 is the data controller responsible for protecting personal information you provide to us in your cv directly within the recruitment process or which we may receive from job and recruiting sites and/or headhunters. Moreover, SCRM will process any additional data that may be submitted or updated during the recruitment process. Your personal data is absolutely essential to participate. We do not collect any special category data. Please kindly do not provide us with such data.

SCRM process your personal data based on your consent and to manage, develop and follow up on the recruitment processes that suits your profile.

Your personal data will not be transferred to third parties unless it is required by law. However, we may communicate your personal data to the suppliers of services which we may contract, and which have the status of data processor.

Your personal data will be kept until your consent is withdrawn and in any case for a maximum period of one year from the finalization of the recruitment process.

You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, cancellation, opposition, restricted processing and data portability with regard to your data at any time. To this effect you may contact the Data Protection Officer appointed by SCRM by sending a letter to the abovementioned postal address or per email to: dataprotection@scrm.lidl. Additionally, you have the right to file a complaint to the Spanish Data Protection Agency if you consider that any of your rights have been infringed.

You can obtain a full version of our Privacy Policy here: https://scrm.lidl

jobs_results.title: BI Engineer
jobs_results.description:
⦿ BI Engineer @BlueThrone ⦿This role is not just a job; it's a calling for those who dare to lead, inspire, and transform the digital landscape. Join us, and let's chart the course to a future written in the stars of success.
🌍 Remote, 100% Work-From-Anywhere 🌍About BlueThrone

Embark on a transformative journey with BlueThrone, a pioneer in the mobile app domain. We specialise in turning promising B2B mobile apps into market leaders, boasting over 49.5 million organic downloads and 4.6 million monthly active users.

With a mission to propel iOS and Android applications to new heights, we've achieved a remarkable ARR organically in just 25 months, exemplifying sustainable growth and innovation. Our team, rich in tech entrepreneurship and mobile marketing expertise, thrives in an environment that values agility, growth mindset, flexibility, creativity, and tangible outcomes.

The Opportunity

BlueThrone is seeking its first Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer to lay the foundation... for our data-driven decision-making process. Reporting directly to the CTO and working closely with the CEO and senior leadership, this role offers the unique opportunity to shape the BI landscape of our rapidly growing company. As a pivotal member of our team, you will harness the power of data to illuminate insights that drive our strategic direction, optimize performance, and unveil new opportunities for growth.
Key Responsibilities

Your Mission
• Analyze and Understand Data: Dive deep into complex data sets to unveil insights that inform business decisions across all levels of the organization.
• Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work directly with the CEO, CTO, and senior leadership to understand data needs, delivering actionable insights that drive strategic initiatives.
• Build Dashboards and Presentations: Design and develop intuitive dashboards and presentations that communicate key metrics and insights to stakeholders, facilitating data-driven decision-making.
• Create and Manage Documentation: Establish and maintain a comprehensive data catalog and documentation, ensuring clarity and accessibility of data insights across the organization.
• Data Modeling: Develop and refine data models that accurately represent business processes, enabling efficient analysis and reporting.
• Communicate Complex Data to Non-Technical Stakeholders: Effectively translate complex data findings into understandable insights for various roles across the organization, ensuring clarity and actionable intelligence for all.

Your Expedition Toolkit
• Proficient in SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
• Experience with cloud-based data warehouses such as BigQuery or AWS Athena.
• Proficient in using BI tools like Metabase, Tableau, or Apache Superset for creating compelling visualizations.
• Solid understanding of data visualization principles and best practices for dashboard design.
• Strong foundation in data analytics, including statistical analysis and the ability to present findings clearly and compellingly.
• Familiarity with data modeling techniques and best practices.
• Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
• Fluent in English, proficiency in Hebrew and/or Russian is a plus.

Nice to Have
• Proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation.
• Experience with Jupyter Notebook or Google Collab for collaborative data exploration and analysis.

Why Join BlueThrone?

Join us in a role that's more than a job - it's a chance to be part of a transformative mission, propelling mobile apps to unparalleled success. We offer not just a career but a lifestyle, blending professional growth with personal well-being.

🚀 Innovative Culture: Be part of a company that's redefining the mobile app market, backed by a business model that blends professional growth with personal well-being.

🏝 Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere, with flexible hours that suit your lifestyle.

💻 Impactful Work: Your role directly contributes to the company's growth and success in the fast-paced world of mobile app acquisitions.

🏆 Collaborative Environment: Join a team of talented professionals in a supportive atmosphere that fosters creativity and innovation.

🃏 Career Development: At BlueThrone, personal and professional growth isn't just a possibility – it's a priority.

🌍 Global Reach: Work with a diverse team of 50 exceptional talents spread across over 19 countries, expanding your professional network and cultural understanding.

Ready to Embark on a journey with BlueThrone? Apply Now!

• Create and Manage Documentation: Establish and maintain a comprehensive data catalog and documentation, ensuring clarity and accessibility of data insights across the organization.
• Data Modeling: Develop and refine data models that accurately represent business processes, enabling efficient analysis and reporting.
• Communicate Complex Data to Non-Technical Stakeholders: Effectively translate complex data findings into understandable insights for various roles across the organization, ensuring clarity and actionable intelligence for all.

Your Expedition Toolkit
• Proficient in SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
• Experience with cloud-based data warehouses such as BigQuery or AWS Athena.
• Proficient in using BI tools like Metabase, Tableau, or Apache Superset for creating compelling visualizations.
• Solid understanding of data visualization principles and best practices for dashboard design.
• Strong foundation in data analytics, including statistical analysis and the ability to present findings clearly and compellingly.
• Familiarity with data modeling techniques and best practices.
• Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
• Fluent in English, proficiency in Hebrew and/or Russian is a plus.

Nice to Have
• Proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation.
• Experience with Jupyter Notebook or Google Collab for collaborative data exploration and analysis.

Join us in a role that's more than a job - it's a chance to be part of a transformative mission, propelling mobile apps to unparalleled success. We offer not just a career but a lifestyle, blending professional growth with personal well-being.

🚀 Innovative Culture: Be part of a company that's redefining the mobile app market, backed by a business model that blends professional growth with personal well-being.

🏝 Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere, with flexible hours that suit your lifestyle.

💻 Impactful Work: Your role directly contributes to the company's growth and success in the fast-paced world of mobile app acquisitions.

🏆 Collaborative Environment: Join a team of talented professionals in a supportive atmosphere that fosters creativity and innovation.

🃏 Career Development: At BlueThrone, personal and professional growth isn't just a possibility – it's a priority.

🌍 Global Reach: Work with a diverse team of 50 exceptional talents spread across over 19 countries, expanding your professional network and cultural understanding.

jobs_results.title: Data & BI Developer
Power BI Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Pride. You Can Experience It, Too.

To support Business Intelligence team in Global Business Services we are looking for a driven Power BI Engineer who is ready to join our mission by architecting, designing, and implementing advanced data engineering and modeling solutions that underpin our BI capabilities. This role is critical for developing a robust, scalable BI infrastructure that supports strategic data analysis, reporting, and visualization needs across Marel.

In your daily work, you will focus on different areas as following:
• Data Engineering & Architecture: Develop and maintain a scalable and efficient BI infrastructure, focusing on data engineering practices that enhance data accessibility, reliability, and quality. Architect data models and ETL processes that serve as the backbone for insightful analytics and BI solutions. Maintain and enforce best practices for Power BI development, including data governance, security, and documentation.
• Advanced BI Solution Design... Lead the design and implementation of complex BI projects, transforming business requirements into technical specifications and actionable insights. Conduct performance tuning and optimization of semantic models, Power BI reports and DAX queries to ensure high performance and usability. Design and develop enterprise-level Power BI semantic model, dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights and support strategic decision-making. Stay abreast of the latest Power BI features and technologies, advocating for their adoption where appropriate.
• Project Leadership & Execution: Drive BI projects from conception to completion, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical standards. Manage project timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations, leveraging agile methodologies where appropriate.
• Data Governance & Quality: Implement data governance policies and practices to maintain the integrity, security, and quality of data within the BI ecosystem. Advocate for best practices in data management and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations.
• BI Platform Optimization: Collaborate with IT to optimize the BI platform for performance and scalability. Lead efforts to enhance data warehousing capabilities and integrate new data sources, ensuring the BI environment evolves to meet changing business needs.
• Community Leadership & Training: Foster a culture of data literacy and BI excellence within Marel. Lead training initiatives, mentor BI practitioners, and share knowledge to elevate the BI competency across the organization.

Who are we?

We are a team of problem-solvers from all over the world. Our mission is to transform the future of food processing by creating a world where quality food is produced sustainably and affordably. Being the world leader in advanced food processing solutions, we’re in a unique position to make this happen – but we need more teammates with diverse perspectives and skills to help us get the most out of this opportunity.

What´s in it for you?

There is nothing like the feeling you get when you do something worthwhile for a living. That said, coming home from work knowing you made a difference is just one of the great things you can experience at Marel. You can also expect:
• Freedom to take initiative and make an impact
• Recognition for your achievements
• An environment of trust and respect
• Opportunities to increase your knowledge

What kind of a person are you?

We encourage each of our 8,000+ employees to bring their unique self to work and aim to make everyone feel recognized, valued and free to explore their potential. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture and welcome new colleagues from all walks of life. We are looking for someone with the following qualifications:
• Academic Background: Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Analytics, or a related field.
• Professional Experience: At least 5-7 years of experience in data engineering, BI architecture, or a closely related field, with demonstrated success in designing and implementing BI solutions.
• Proven experience: Power BI enterprise solution development, including semantic models, composite models, report and dashboard creation, DAX, and Power Query & strong understanding of dimensional modeling principles and experience with SQL and relational databases.
• Technical Expertise: Knowledge of data processing, data architecture, and BI best practices. Advanced skills in Power BI, data modeling, ETL processes, and data engineering methodologies. Proficient in SQL and knowledge in Fabric, Cloud, Azure, Databricks, Python is a plus
• Language Proficiency: Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to dissect complex problems and engineer efficient solutions. Skilled in statistical analysis and leveraging data for strategic decision-making
• Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills, adept at data storytelling and influencing decisions through insights. Collaborative team player able to work effectively across technical and business teams.

Interested?

If you want to experience pride, please let us know by applying for the role. For more information about this position, please contact our Talent Acquisition Specialist: Katarzyna Strzelczyk-Kus: Katarzyna.strzelczyk-kus@marel.com
